system.itemDescription: Veiled in myth and legend, the enigmatic pandaren remain a mystery to most of Azeroth. Their noble history spans thousands of years, predating human empires and even the Sundering. Native to Pandaria, their homeland vanished behind a shrouding mist during that cataclysm. A second pandaren civilization thrives aboard the giant turtle Shen-zin Su, known as the “Wandering Isle.” Unlike their secluded kin, these pandaren roam Azeroth's seas in search of adventure.
